description: This file defines an IRC channel plugin for the openclaw project, importing core plugin functionalities and specific channel and runtime modules, then exporting and registering the plugin with metadata.

methods.name: defineChannelPluginEntry
methods.description: Registers a new channel plugin with specified configuration including id, name, description, plugin implementation, and runtime setup.

calls: defineChannelPluginEntry({ id: "irc", name: "IRC", description: "IRC channel plugin", plugin: ircPlugin, setRuntime: setIrcRuntime })
